senses.gloss:
(ऋ) भेषृ r. 1st cl. (भेषति-ते)
1 To fear or dread.
2 To go.

n. (-जं)
1 A remedy, a drug, a medicament.
2 A kind of fennel, (Nigella Indica.)
E.
भेष here interpreted disease, जि to conquer, aff. ड; or भिषज् a root of a particular class, and अच् aff.

n. (-ङ्गं)
The vehicle or medium in which medicine is administered, as water gruel, &c.
E.
भेषज a drug, and अङ्ग a limb or part.
